gmailIntro: Let Kun find and read email, then send only with your approval.
gmailReadPermission: Read and search the messages you request.
gmailSendPermission: Send email, with your approval for each message.
gmailApprovalRequired: Review the complete recipients, subject and message before sending.
gmailLocalCredentials: Google authorization credentials are encrypted on this device.
gmailSharingConsent: Allow this conversation to process requested email using my configured models.
gmailSharingDetails: Your requested email content, addresses and relevant conversation context are provided to the currently configured models.
gmailSharingScope: Off by default and limited to this conversation. The permission continues when you change models.
gmailModelDataPolicy: Email follows your selected models, routing and failover settings. Retention and training policies depend on those providers and account settings; Kun makes no universal guarantee. Gmail authorization credentials are never provided to models.
gmailHistoryAndRemoteViewing: Email-related conversation and operational records may remain on this device. If you enable paired-device access, your authenticated device can view this conversation through your selected connection or tunnel. Gmail credentials are not sent to remote devices.
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured in this app. Update Kun or contact the administrator.
gmailReconnectRequired: Google access expired or was revoked. Connect again.
gmailWaiting: Complete Google authorization in your system browser, then return to Kun.
gmailStatusFailed: Could not check Gmail. Refresh and try again.
gmailCancelled: Connection cancelled. You can retry at any time.
gmailAuthorizationFailed: Google authorization was not completed. Retry and allow the required permissions.
gmailPollFailed: Could not check authorization. Refresh or cancel and retry.
gmailActionFailed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
gmailGrantRequired: Connect Gmail and allow this conversation to process email before continuing.
gmailDisconnectDetails: Disconnecting deletes local Gmail credentials and all conversation grants. Existing history remains until you delete it.
gmailRevokeWarning: Google revocation can remove grants for other Kun clients in this Google project, including Google sign-in. You may need to authorize those clients again. Existing local history remains.
gmailReady: Gmail is available to this conversation
